name: Lamplighter
designNote: Aha: Sol trades his half-coin for light, and his light is Lune's shadow. He walks the top row so Lune can cross her shadow bridge in his shadow, then lights his own sunglass bridge down to his goal.
hints: There's no lantern. Who could carry the light?
Sol takes the light altar, then walks the top row so his shadow covers Lune's bridge.
